sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)

literature_notes: Ledger lines L1 and L2 (PMC12480533) confirm that a FLAG-tagged full-length SLC30A10 construct is expressed and surface-immunolabeled under non-permeabilized conditions at 4°C, establishing that the FLAG tag is extracellular. However, neither line names the residue position, the loop, nor any other landmark that would pin the insertion site. SLC30A10 has three extracellular spans (EC1: residues 33–34, 2 aa; EC2: residues 102–114, 13 aa; EC3: residues 265–282, 18 aa) and both termini are intracellular (N-terminus residues 1–11; C-terminus residues 297–485). Because there is no sole extracellular terminus, the 'topology_derived' rule does not apply. With three candidate loops and no named loop or residue in the ledger, the position cannot be pinned to any one of them. Choosing among the three loops would require inventing a position, which is forbidden. Zero sites qualify.
